migration_progress.summary: [VERIFIED] Source code analysis confirms Phase 1 (Runtime Foundation) and Phase 2 (Connection Layer) are fully implemented. Phase 3 is currently in progress, with the initial ExecutionRuntime created. The next step is to begin work on Phase 4.

decisions.decision: Adopt an Execution-centric model for all tasks.
decisions.reason: To support long-running, pausable, and cancellable workflows, moving beyond the simple stateless request/response model.

RuntimeKernel.description: The central coordinator for the AI Runtime Backend, managing the lifecycle of all runtimes.

ConnectionRuntime.description: Manages client connections, transport, heartbeat, and initial message routing.

ExecutionRuntime.description: Manages the lifecycle of Executions (create, get, update state, cancel).

IExecutionStore.description: Abstract interface for a storage backend for Executions.

RuntimeKernel::startup.description: Starts the kernel and all registered runtimes in a controlled sequence.

ConnectionRuntime::_handle_register_mess.description: Handles a 'REGISTER' message from a new client, adding it to the client registry.

ExecutionRuntime::create_execution.description: Creates a new Execution object, persists it, and returns it. This is the starting point for any new trackable task.
